name: thumbnail-skill
title_zh: 按既定分镜稿渲染缩略图，落盘带出处
tagline_zh: 视频 Agent 已定好画面、文案、版式？交给它，安全落成 PNG/JPEG。不猜内容、不跑偏，每张图自带出处。
tagline_en: When your video agent has fixed the shot, text & layout, this renders it to PNG/JPEG safely—no guessing, no.
desc_en: Deterministic thumbnail rendering execution Skill for the AI Video Production Ecosystem. Use it when a caller (normally video-production-agent) has already decided exactly what a thumbnail should show - which still image or which explicit video timestamp, what text, what layout - and needs it rendered safely to PNG/JPEG with provenance. Do NOT use it to choose what a thumbnail should show, pick a
why_zh: 确定性优先：输入即输出，不引入模型随机性。渲染结果可复现、可审计。
why_en: Deterministic by design: spec in, image out—no model randomness. Reproducible, auditable, built for the last mile of multi-agent.
limit_zh: 只认已定稿的缩略图规格（时间戳/图片+文案+版式），不负责创意决策。
limit_en: Only renders decided specs (timestamp/image + text + layout); no creative choices. Needs ffmpeg & ImageMagick. Outputs PNG/JPEG only—no GIF or alpha.
title_en: Render thumbnails from decided specs, with provenance
